claim_text: Psyllium products require adequate fluid and safe swallowing; people with dysphagia or difficulty swallowing may be at risk of choking or obstruction and should not receive an automatic recommendation.
health_goal_or_outcome: Prevent unsafe supplementation and ensure clinical context is considered.

population.other_context: People reporting swallowing difficulty who are considering psyllium.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Dietary and supplemental sources; verify exact product form and label.
evidence_summary: Official psyllium product warnings describe choking risk and the need to take the product with adequate fluid.
limitations: Warnings and fluid instructions must be checked against the exact marketed product and jurisdiction.
Exact source passages and underlying evidence require full appraisal before approval.
